rationale_md: Scotland enters this Group C clash as the clear favorite with a 150-point Elo rating advantage over Haiti, reflecting the gulf in quality between the European side and their Caribbean opponents. The model gives Scotland a 43% chance of victory compared to Haiti's 33%, though the relatively modest probability gap suggests this could be more competitive than the raw ratings indicate. Scotland will need to convert their technical superiority into goals early to avoid getting drawn into a tense battle where Haiti's organization could frustrate their ambitions.
